acceptance_cases.observation: Bob/Carol offline; Alice sends and stops — Both later retrieve and authenticate the same message through their own copies, without Alice's running process or secret directory
Sender self-copy — Alice retrieves/reconciles her copy after intact-store restart without a second application effect or acknowledgement
Received return path — Bob/Carol save before acknowledging; Alice retrieves their acknowledgements later; acknowledgement delivery creates no loop
Lost PUT response and duplicated uploads — Original bytes, position and receipt returned; no extra entry or quota charge
Relay restart / write failures — Committed objects/key/run/receipts survive; pre-commit failure yields no valid Stored receipt; uncertain outcomes recover through retry
Client crashes around outgoing/incoming/ack commits — No send before outbox commit; no Received before saved authenticated state; pending downloads and exact retries recover
One honest relay unavailable — Two remaining instances can hold the complete set; an already complete set retains at least one acknowledged copy per object
Missing recipient copy/chunk/manifest — Whole-vault Stored is withheld without the same two complete replicas; incomplete transfers generate no Received
Altered ciphertext, wrong recipient/vault/roster/sender — Refusal or quarantine; no application effect or Received
Valid shared append credential, forged inner sender — Storage can succeed, but client authentication refuses the message
Duplicate/reordered objects, early Received/prerequisite — One local logical effect; dependencies remain pending and reconcile without a global relay ordering assumption
Conflicting body under authenticated logical ID — Preserve conflict; no silent replacement or second effect
Forged/mismatched receipt; duplicate relay key URLs — Receipt refused or key counted once
Capacity reached — Reject new objects, retain accepted ones, allow duplicate retry/read; no eviction after Received
Malformed entries / temporarily missing object — Quarantine or durable pending task; later valid entries progress; restart retains outstanding retrieval work
Invalid provisioning revision / creation retry — Refuse conflicts/stale replacement; identical creation does not undo a later append-capability update
Canonical encoding / HPKE vectors / boundaries — Refuse noncanonical/unknown versions and malformed lengths; selected suite vectors and exact 64 KiB/chunk boundaries pass
